bekkerson.tagline: We have a guild for that.
bekkerson.blurb: Tech nerds with their own conference, their own podcast and a guild for guilds.

accentura.tagline: We have a deck for that.
accentura.blurb: Global, thorough and always ready with 140 slides and a partner flying in from Copenhagen.

knowitall.blurb: Broad, big and happy to acquire anything that stands still long enough.

soppsteria.blurb: Cheap, efficient and suspiciously good at delivering from several time zones at once.

kompottas.tagline: Everything's better with a bit of jam.
kompottas.blurb: Solid people with a taste for both architecture and waffles.

iteraigjen.tagline: We'll do it once more. And once more.
iteraigjen.blurb: Agile to the bone. The sprint is never quite over.

smiles.blurb: Small local offices and a wellbeing survey that always says 100%.

webstepdans.blurb: Rhythmic deliveries and a surprisingly good Christmas party show.

kantegne.tagline: We draw it first. On the whiteboard. For a while.
kantegne.blurb: Design-driven and proudly from Trondheim. The whiteboards are full.

tietoevig.tagline: Your project lasts forever. So do we.
tietoevig.blurb: Nordic giant with a framework agreement on nearly everything.

bouffet.tagline: Help yourself. Every discipline on one table.
bouffet.blurb: Big, broad and always something for every taste.

invariant.tagline: Same high quality, whatever the input.
invariant.blurb: A small, open and extremely tidy company. The salary sheet is online.

reiterate.tagline: Have you tried turning it off and on again?
reiterate.blurb: A collective of curious developers who'd rather build their own products.

geita.blurb: Cloud specialists who are happiest where there are no railings.

fargestift.tagline: We colour in your cloud bill.
fargestift.blurb: Licences, cloud and a surprisingly large data department.

kappgjemini.blurb: Big, efficient and always ready to scale. Up and down.

nattlys.tagline: We light up the darkest backlogs.
nattlys.blurb: Swedish, flat structure and consultants who look remarkably well-rested.

hikkeq.blurb: Swedish quality and a weekly fika nobody is allowed to skip.

riddertech.blurb: Data engineers in shining armour. And hoodies.

rektor.tagline: My office. Bring a good PR.
rektor.blurb: Finnish precision, sauna culture and code reviews that are strict but fair.

futuriis.blurb: Finnish design house with a knack for service design and lunch.

solitaer.tagline: We play best alone, but deliver as a team.
solitaer.blurb: Data-loving Finns with a soft spot for the public sector.

trigaffel.blurb: Danish developers with their own conference and strong opinions on Erlang.

nettkompaniet.tagline: Public sector? We've read the procurement act. Twice.
nettkompaniet.blurb: Danish giant delivering big systems to big agencies.

navet.name: NAVet
navet.blurb: Norway's largest collection of case-handling systems. Always mid-modernisation.
navet.about: Hundreds of teams, thousands of rules and a shared goal of getting people paid on time. A modern platform, real public value and a coffee machine that has seen everything.

skatteetatn.name: Tax Office
skatteetatn.blurb: Likes your spreadsheet. Would like to see it.
skatteetatn.about: Solid, thorough and deeply fond of documentation. Deliver and you'll stay a long time, and nobody minds you spending two weeks on a sequence diagram.

veivesen.name: Public Roads Office
veivesen.blurb: Asphalt, road tolls and a surprising number of APIs.
veivesen.about: Roads, ferries and a system portfolio spanning four decades. Every decision passes three steering groups, but once it's made, it's set in asphalt.

helsesov.name: Health South-East-West
helsesov.blurb: A health trust with one medical record and three systems to read it.
helsesov.about: The work saves lives, and you feel it. The tech is older than most of the developers, the office is an old hospital wing, and everything needs sign-off from someone on call.

kommunenorge.name: Municipalities Inc.
kommunenorge.blurb: 356 municipalities, one shared procurement and a tight budget.
kommunenorge.about: Hundreds of municipalities that agreed to buy together. Lovely for the common good, heavy going for progress. Nobody is in a hurry, and nobody quite knows who's in charge.

laanekassen.name: Student Loans for Life
laanekassen.blurb: Student loans, grants and an inbox full of worried parents.
laanekassen.about: A surprisingly modern agency with tidy teams and a product owner who actually answers email. A calm pace, except in August.

dnbank.name: DNBank
dnbank.blurb: Big bank with a big appetite for anything called a platform.
dnbank.about: Big budgets, glass facades and a procurement team that wants 15 years on every CV. The pace is high and working from home is something you apply for.

equinaer.name: Equinær
equinaer.blurb: Energy, data and a board that loves the word "transformation".
equinaer.about: An energy company mid-transition, with a data warehouse the size of an oil field. Cool problems, good people and an award-winning canteen.

postenbring.name: Post & Bring-Me
postenbring.blurb: Parcels, tracking and a warehouse full of Raspberry Pis.
postenbring.about: Logistics is harder than it looks, and they know it. Down to earth, pragmatic and light on bureaucracy, though the office is next to a freight terminal.

kryptonitt.name: Kryptonitt
kryptonitt.blurb: Fintech startup with a big pitch deck and a small budget. Usually pays on time.
kryptonitt.about: Everyone wants to work here, at least for a while. The newest tech, beanbags and working from Bali. The strategy changes every Friday, and nobody knows if they'll exist next year.

tipptopp.name: Norsk Tipp-Topp
tipptopp.blurb: Games, lotto and a responsibility department that always joins the meeting.
tipptopp.about: A gaming company with solid finances, a mature product organisation and strict rules on responsible gambling. The office is in Hamar, which is nicer than you'd think.

rutah.name: Rutah
rutah.blurb: Public transport, ticket apps and a real-time display that's almost always right.
rutah.about: Public transport for a whole region. Everyone uses the apps, so the work shows, and the developers like that. Young teams, no obsession with years of experience and lots of real-time data.

telenorr.name: Telenorr
telenorr.blurb: Telco with a network across the Nordics and a procurement team across Asia.
telenorr.about: Big, old and full of matrix. The office at Fornebu is lovely, but procurement will switch vendors overnight if the price is right.

sparebank123.name: SpareBank 1-2-3
sparebank123.blurb: Local bank with local decisions and national ambitions.
sparebank123.about: A local bank that remembers you. The tech is steady rather than exciting, but they stay with their vendors for years.

genai_hype.name: GenAI hype
genai_hype.desc: Everyone wants AI. Data people are worth their weight in gold.

cloud_migration.name: Cloud migration
cloud_migration.desc: Data centres are emptying. Cloud people and architects are in demand.

public_budget_cuts.name: Public budget cuts
public_budget_cuts.desc: Fewer tenders, and price matters more than before.

design_renaissance.name: Design renaissance
design_renaissance.desc: User experience is back on the agenda. Designers and frontend are in demand.

data_mesh_mania.name: Data mesh mania
data_mesh_mania.desc: Everyone needs data products. Nobody quite knows what they are.

pm_winter.name: Project manager winter
pm_winter.desc: Product teams are in, project managers are out.

security_panic.name: Security panic
security_panic.desc: A big breach has scared everyone. Security suddenly matters.

boom.name: Boom times
boom.desc: Money is flowing. More tenders than in years.

ai_act_freeze.name: AI freeze
ai_act_freeze.desc: Clients have paused data projects while their lawyers read the AI Act.

krone_crash.name: Krone crash
krone_crash.desc: A weak krone and nervous clients. Price matters more than usual.

linkedin_influencer.name: LinkedIn influencer
linkedin_influencer.desc: Boosts your employer brand, but gets a lot of offers.

kaffesnobb.name: Coffee snob
kaffesnobb.desc: Only happy with a good social culture (and good coffee).

tenx_ego.name: 10x ego
tenx_ego.desc: Impresses in tenders, but can get on colleagues' nerves.

remote_hardliner.name: Remote hardliner
remote_hardliner.desc: Demands remote work. Otherwise loyalty drops.

mentor.name: Mentor
mentor.desc: Levels up colleagues in the same discipline.

conference_speaker.name: Conference speaker
conference_speaker.desc: Adds reputation and impresses in tenders.

workaholic.name: Workaholic
workaholic.desc: Delivers a lot, but wears out.

certification_collector.name: Certification collector
certification_collector.desc: Has every certificate. The CV is four pages long.

spy_bids.name: Peek at the tender
spy_bids.desc: See competitors' bids on one tender before the deadline.

spy_salaries.name: Salary espionage
spy_salaries.desc: Find out what a firm pays and how its people are doing.

plant_mole.name: Plant a mole
plant_mole.desc: A "trainee" gives you insight into a firm for four quarters.

afterwork_poach.name: Afterwork recruiting
afterwork_poach.desc: Take a star from another firm out for drinks and see what happens.

silent_outsource.name: Silent outsourcing
silent_outsource.desc: Let an offshore team do part of the work on a contract. The client doesn't need to know.

cv_pad.name: Polish the CVs
cv_pad.desc: A bit more experience here, a certificate there. Improves bid quality.

ghost_cv.name: Ghost CVs
ghost_cv.desc: Offer consultants you "might hire". Removes the capacity penalty.

bait_and_switch.name: Bait and switch
bait_and_switch.desc: Move the promised stars off a contract and send juniors instead.

rumor.name: Spread rumours
rumor.desc: Mention something in passing at the next breakfast seminar.

dn_leak.name: Leak to the press
dn_leak.desc: Tip off a journalist about another firm. Gives the target a scandal.

linkedin_post.name: Passive-aggressive LinkedIn post
linkedin_post.desc: "Some firms apparently think…" Boosts your brand and dents theirs.

awards.coffee_machine: Best Coffee Machine in the Industry

bankrupt.title: Bankrupt
bankrupt.desc: The receiver has taken over the foosball table. It was fun while it lasted.

ethical_champion.title: Ethical beacon
ethical_champion.desc: Biggest in the industry without cheating once. Tor from compliance shed a small tear.

cheated_to_top.title: Cheated your way to the top
cheated_to_top.desc: Number one in the industry. Don't ask how.

industry_leader.title: The industry's Bekkerson
industry_leader.desc: Number one in the market. Competitors form guilds about you.

caught_pants_down.title: Caught red-handed
caught_pants_down.desc: You got caught, more than once. The business press has a tag just for you.

solid_challenger.title: Solid challenger
solid_challenger.desc: Among the top five. Next time, maybe the top spot.

midfield.title: Safe midfield
midfield.desc: A proper consultancy with proper people. Nobody writes about you, and that's fine.

acquired.title: Acquired for peanuts
acquired.desc: Accentura bought you. The logo is gone, but the coffee machine got to stay.

full_house.name: Bill at least 90 % of the time in a quarter

big_win.name: Win a tender for at least 15 consultants

happy_client.name: Get a client above 80 in satisfaction

top_three.name: Become one of the three most valuable firms

hyperscaler.name: Cloud vendor partner
hyperscaler.desc: Gold partner with a big cloud vendor. Clients like the logo on the slides.

ai_lab.name: AI partnership
ai_lab.desc: Early access to models and a certificate for the reception.

design_guild.name: Design guild
design_guild.desc: Membership of a design guild with its own awards and its own black jumpers.

agile_institute.name: Agile institute
agile_institute.desc: Certified scrum masters with extra letters after their names.

framework_vendor.name: Framework partner
framework_vendor.desc: Official partner of a frontend framework. This week, at least.

enterprise_vendor.name: Enterprise partner
enterprise_vendor.desc: Partner of a big business-software vendor. The licences are pricey, the badge is free.

architecture_forum.name: Architecture forum
architecture_forum.desc: A permanent seat on the forum where the boxes and arrows are decided.

academy.name: The Academy
academy.desc: An in-house course programme. Everyone gets a little better every quarter, up to level {{max}}.

sales.name: The sales team
sales.desc: People who love tender processes. +{{bonus}} quality on every bid.

nearshore.name: The nearshore centre
nearshore.desc: Your own people in Gdańsk to fill gaps. Freelancers cost {{pct}} of what they bill instead of {{normal}}.

fagdag_speaker.name: Tech-day regular
fagdag_speaker.desc: Always takes the floor at tech day, time slot or not.

docs_volunteer.name: Documents things
docs_volunteer.desc: Writes documentation voluntarily. Nobody knows why.

coffee_nerd.name: Coffee nerd
coffee_nerd.desc: Keeps a grinder on the desk and has opinions on water hardness.

linkedin_daily.name: LinkedIn regular
linkedin_daily.desc: Posts something inspiring on LinkedIn every morning before nine.

cert_hoarder.name: Certificate hoarder
cert_hoarder.desc: Has more certifications than days off.

explains_well.name: Good explainer
explains_well.desc: Explains things so even the boss gets it.

client_whisperer.name: Client whisperer
client_whisperer.desc: Clients ask for them by name.

slack_emoji.name: Emoji artist
slack_emoji.desc: Has made forty custom Slack emoji. Every one of them gets used.

never_offline.name: Always online
never_offline.desc: Replies on Slack at eleven at night.

home_office.name: Home-office loyalist
home_office.desc: Has been to the office twice, both times for cake.

rewrites_everything.name: Wants to rewrite it all
rewrites_everything.desc: Believes most things would be better in Rust.

been_here_forever.name: Remembers everything
been_here_forever.desc: Knows every secret of the old codebase.

raspberry_pi.name: Home lab
raspberry_pi.desc: Has three Raspberry Pis at home and a plan for each.

vim_user.name: Vim user
vim_user.desc: Has never left vim. Possibly because they don't know how.

cake_baker.name: Baker
cake_baker.desc: Bakes a cake every Friday. Morale rises noticeably.

dark_mode.name: Dark mode
dark_mode.desc: Refuses to look at anything with a light background.

side_projects.name: Side projects
side_projects.desc: Has fourteen unfinished side projects and can't wait for number fifteen.

standup_novelist.name: Long stand-ups
standup_novelist.desc: Stand-up updates run ten minutes and have a twist at the end.

quiet_genius.name: Quietly brilliant
quiet_genius.desc: Says little in meetings and delivers a lot afterwards.

focus_time.name: Focus time
focus_time.desc: Has blocked the whole calendar as “focus time”.

jira_poet.name: Jira poet
jira_poet.desc: Writes Jira tickets in three acts.

board_gamer.name: Board gamer
board_gamer.desc: Runs a board game night every other Thursday.

runs_to_work.name: Runs to work
runs_to_work.desc: Runs to work and is happy to tell you about it.

loud_keyboard.name: Mechanical keyboard
loud_keyboard.desc: The keyboard sounds like hail on a tin roof.

framework_hopper.name: Framework hopper
framework_hopper.desc: Has tried every new framework by lunch.

excel_wizard.name: Excel wizard
excel_wizard.desc: Can do anything in Excel, including things one shouldn't.

plant_parent.name: Plant parent
plant_parent.desc: Has thirty plants at the desk, every one of them named.

five_whys.name: Asks why
five_whys.desc: Asks “why?” five times before anything gets decided.

late_bloomer.name: Late bloomer
late_bloomer.desc: Started slowly, but is picking up speed.
